parameters.command:
WATCH_DIR="${CAPTION_WATCH_DIR:-/home/node/files/inbox}"
OUT_DIR="${CAPTION_OUTPUT_DIR:-/home/node/files/captions}"
WORK_DIR="${CAPTION_WORK_DIR:-/home/node/files/work}"
WHISPER_MODEL="${WHISPER_MODEL:-medium}"
WHISPER_LANGUAGE="${WHISPER_LANGUAGE:-en}"
OLLAMA_MODEL="${OLLAMA_MODEL:-llama3.1:8b}"

mkdir -p "$WATCH_DIR" "$OUT_DIR" "$WORK_DIR"

VIDEO="$(find "$WATCH_DIR" -type f \( -iname '*.mp4' -o -iname '*.mov' -o -iname '*.mkv' -o -iname '*.avi' -o -iname '*.webm' \) | sort | head -n 1)"

if [ -z "$VIDEO" ]; then
  echo '{"found":false}'
  exit 0
fi

BASENAME="$(basename "$VIDEO")"
STEM="${BASENAME%.*}"
CAPTION_DIR="$OUT_DIR/$STEM"
mkdir -p "$CAPTION_DIR"

SRT_PATH="$CAPTION_DIR/$STEM.srt"
VTT_PATH="$CAPTION_DIR/$STEM.vtt"
CLEANED_TXT_PATH="$CAPTION_DIR/$STEM.cleaned.txt"

if [ -f "$SRT_PATH" ] && [ -f "$VTT_PATH" ]; then
  echo '{"found":false,"skipped":"already_captioned"}'
  exit 0
fi

AUDIO_PATH="$WORK_DIR/$STEM.wav"
WHISPER_JSON_PATH="$WORK_DIR/$STEM.json"

export VIDEO BASENAME STEM CAPTION_DIR AUDIO_PATH WHISPER_JSON_PATH SRT_PATH VTT_PATH CLEANED_TXT_PATH WHISPER_MODEL WHISPER_LANGUAGE OLLAMA_MODEL

python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import os
print(json.dumps({
  "found": True,
  "videoPath": os.environ["VIDEO"],
  "baseName": os.environ["BASENAME"],
  "stem": os.environ["STEM"],
  "captionDir": os.environ["CAPTION_DIR"],
  "audioPath": os.environ["AUDIO_PATH"],
  "whisperJsonPath": os.environ["WHISPER_JSON_PATH"],
  "srtPath": os.environ["SRT_PATH"],
  "vttPath": os.environ["VTT_PATH"],
  "cleanedTxtPath": os.environ["CLEANED_TXT_PATH"],
  "whisperModel": os.environ["WHISPER_MODEL"],
  "whisperLanguage": os.environ["WHISPER_LANGUAGE"],
  "ollamaModel": os.environ["OLLAMA_MODEL"]
}))
PY

python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
caption_dir = Path("{{$json.captionDir}}")
json_path = caption_dir / "{{$json.stem}}.json"
print(json.dumps({"whisper": json.loads(json_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))}))
PY

python3 - <<'PY'
import base64
from pathlib import Path

outputs = [
  ("{{$json.srtPath}}", "{{$json.srtBase64}}"),
  ("{{$json.vttPath}}", "{{$json.vttBase64}}"),
  ("{{$json.cleanedTxtPath}}", "{{$json.cleanedTxtBase64}}"),
]

for path_str, data_b64 in outputs:
  path = Path(path_str)
  path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
  path.write_bytes(base64.b64decode(data_b64))

print("saved")
PY
